gloss: to go well; to turn out well; to succeed

definitions.gloss: to go well; to turn out well; to succeed
definitions.explanation: For a plan, effort, or situation to proceed smoothly and produce a good result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{上手|うま}くいった。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上手|うま}くいく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Things don't always go according to plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上手|うま}くいかなかった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: At first it didn't go well, but as I practiced many times, I gradually got better.

notes:
A very common conversational expression composed of {上手|うま}く (the adverbial form of {上手|うま}い, meaning skillfully or well) and いく (to go). Often written in kana as ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いく. The negative form {上手|うま}くいかない is equally common and means "to not go well."

USAGE:
- Frequently used with subjects like ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work), ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (plans), ⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧ (relationships)
- The negative {上手|うま}くいかない is used just as often as the positive form
- Can be written as ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いく (all kana) or {上手|うま}くいく
- Often used with conditional forms: {上手|うま}くいけば (if it goes well), {上手|うま}くいったら (if it goes well)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|うま}くいく: work goes well
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|うま}くいく: the plan works out
- {上手|うま}くいけば: if things go well
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{上手|うま}くいかない: things just don't go well
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧とおり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上手|うま}くいく: to go as expected

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to proceed smoothly — more formal; often used for projects and processes
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: to succeed — focuses on achieving a specific goal
- はかどる: to make progress — specifically about work or tasks advancing efficiently
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to handle well — focuses on the person's skill rather than the outcome
